title: Standing like a post
explanation: Someone remains standing stiffly or motionlessly. In the source’s example, the speaker has already invited the person to sit; the comparison conveys impatience, not a diagnosis of the person’s motives.
meaning_odia: ବସିବାକୁ କହିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥିର ହୋଇ ଠିଆ ରହିବାକୁ ଖୁଣ୍ଟ ସହ ତୁଳନା କରାଯାଇଛି। କହୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ଅଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଏଥିରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
usage_example: After repeatedly offering a chair, a host asks why the visitor is still standing motionless. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source’s invitation-to-sit example supports this limited reading; no claim of laziness or incapacity is warranted.
